description: 【北海道】航空レーザーデータ(H26浦河道路設計) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 総合政策部. 胆振総合振興局室蘭建設管理部浦河出張所 浦河町 座標参照系 EPSG2454 JGD2000平面直角座標系12系. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 総合政策部. Its tags are 3次元点群データ, DEM, 北海道, 航空レーザー. It offers 9 resource(s) in jpeg, kml, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
